messages.author: d22afc2ed7b88fdf
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] שימוש בקואורדינטות למיפוי -R
parts:
Thanks Tal!

I just split my Coordinates data into Longtitude and Altitude columns and used library ("leaflet") with the following code:

Map <- leaflet() %>%
       addTiles() %>%  
       addMarkers(lng=Coord$Lng, lat=Coord$Lat)

Map

The output is an interactive map of Israel with markers for all the data, exactly what I was looking for.  

Erez
